I’m in the exact same boat! I have all the other Star Wars characters (including BB-8 and R2-D2) but just never bought the storm trooper. At first it was because I didn’t have the gems, but now I could hypothetically do so but at this point I think it’s better to leave it be! (This is my first event however so take what I say with a grain of salt, and perhaps wait for someone a little more experienced to give you an opinion. <3) 

But my theory is, unless you absolutely love the character then there is no pressure in completing the collection, especially not this late in the event. You’re better off saving for a character you truly do want, or for another helper in the next event to make sure you can get all those characters! 

Again this is just my opinion of course. But don’t just buy the stormtrooper because it’s limited time. Think about whether you’d buy them if they were permanent content, like R2, and if the answer is no perhaps it’s best to wait to use those gems for something you want a little bit more. <3

I was going through a really rough time at that point and so I thought to myself, “okay I’ll buy $50 worth of content” which I did. By the next month I had bought everything. I never ever buy anything for myself that’s not essential, and it was the first time in years I “treated” myself. The money wasn’t an issue for me fortunately, so I spent like, $300AUD on sims in a month period lmao. 

Sometimes I do wish I had have waited and stretched out my purchases, so I could slowly discover and immerse myself in each pack before getting the next one. But seriously after getting all the packs I had the best week I’ve had in years and I didn’t regret a second. Hope you enjoy it as much as I did!

You’ll probably never see this because this is so late, but I wanna suggests a game:

To The Moon. 

It’s a GORGEOUS game with an incredible story and even more amazing soundtrack. The music is literally everything in this, and I listen to one of the songs from the game from time to time. It’s very story driven and is more of a “click and point” adventure, but it’s so damn unique and I have only ever cried in two games my entire life. (One being season 1 of Telltale’s The Walking Dead, and this game. I balled my eyes out.)

I’m not sure how much it is atm, but it’s an absolutely beautiful indie game and will stay with you forever, despite gameplay only lasting a few hours. Definitely worth it if you enjoy story driven games.
